inc.0.p: Your style, your colours and your logo. No templates you have already seen everywhere.
inc.1.p: Almost all your customers look for you on their phone: that is where it has to look flawless.

legal.p.0: We use no cookies, analytics, pixels or trackers of any kind.
legal.p.1: The website has no forms. If you write to us on WhatsApp or by email, we use your details only to answer you and prepare your demo or quote, and we never share them.
legal.p.2: We keep the conversation while we work together and delete it when you ask us to, except what the law requires us to keep.
legal.p.3: WhatsApp is a Meta service with its own privacy policy. Email reaches the owner's mailbox through Cloudflare Email Routing.
legal.p.4: The website is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.), which may log technical connection data, such as the IP address, for security.
legal.purpose: This website describes the website design and development services of IsBusiness for businesses. It sells nothing online and has no customer area.
legal.rights: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, or object to its use, by writing to contacto@isuniverse.dev. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
